WITH event_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(avg_remaining) AS average_remaining,
        AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate
    FROM event_metrics
    GROUP BY status
),
all_events_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_event_avg_remaining
    FROM event_metrics
)
SELECT
    sm.status,
    sm.average_remaining,
    sm.average_overspend_rate,
    sm.average_remaining / NULLIF(aem.mean_event_avg_remaining, 0) AS average_remaining_divided_by_all_events_mean
FROM status_metrics AS sm
CROSS JOIN all_events_mean AS aem;

assumptions.assumption: A zero budget amount makes the overspend rate undefined and is excluded from that average; NULL values are ignored by AVG. Events without a matching budget line do not contribute, since no event-level line averages can be computed for them.
